scope: Correct the source-confirmed DXF wire-kind mismatch for HATCH/MPOLYGON gradient group 431 without guessing a semantic mapping for DWG-side color-method metadata.

observed: Autodesk's HATCH reference documents the gradient control fields and per-stop value/color groups, but does not define group 431 as an integer color-method field.
Autodesk classifies the 430-439 group-code range as strings.
The reviewed peer API model does not expose a per-gradient-stop integer color-method mapping; it is corroborative only, not normative or independent of related Rust lineage.
primaryResearch.evidenceBoundary: Absence of group 431 from Autodesk's entity table is not proof that no producer uses it. The type table establishes its wire value is a string, not the meaning of that string. No mapping to GradientStop::colorMethod is inferred.

implementation.parser431: No longer parsed as an integer; uses existing unknown-group handling, while subsequent string-valued groups remain aligned and readable.
implementation.writer431: No longer emitted as a four-byte integer.
implementation.unsupportedProjectionPolicy: An active DXF gradient with nonzero DWG-side colorMethod is rejected by shared HATCH/MPOLYGON preflight before record publication. Inactive stale values remain ignored.
implementation.otherFields: Existing groups 432/433 string handling is unchanged; their entity-specific semantics are still not qualified.
